stem: What key idea do the details in the section “Calming Benefits” support?

options.label: A
options.text: Resources should be gathered before training a pet.

options.label: B
options.text: Many people are unfamiliar with how to train an animal.

options.label: C
options.text: Many people have trouble dealing with stressful situations.

options.label: D
options.text: A trained pet can reduce the stress people experience.
